_comment: M5Burner / LauncherHub catalog + install manifest template for ESP32-DIV on the M5Stack Tab5. Category MUST be 'tab5' (the Launcher fetches api.launcherhub.net/firmwares?category=tab5). Publishing to the store needs an M5Stack account + approval — see INSTALL.md Path B. Fill the TODO fields and host the .bin at the sources.firmware URL.

publish.name: ESP32-DIV
publish.author: TODO-your-handle
publish.description: ESP32-DIV pentest multitool ported to the M5Stack Tab5 (ESP32-P4): WiFi scan/AP/STA, BLE scan + advertise (Spoofer/SourApple/AirTag) + skimmer detector, SD tools, themeable touch UI.

install._image_size_note: image_size is the byte size of dist/ESP32-DIV.bin; update it whenever the app is rebuilt (the value above was current at the last build).

_alt_full_image._comment: Alternative: publish the merged full image instead of the app-only image.
